name: Chan Chan Archaeological Zone
description: Chan Chan is a vast ruined city of sun-baked mud brick on Peru's arid northern coast, five kilometres west of Trujillo. It was the capital of the Chimú kingdom until the Incas conquered it around 1470. Once the largest city in pre-Columbian America, it was divided into nine walled royal compounds, each with its own plazas and storerooms. Its fragile earthen walls place it on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
